judge.rationale: The finding explicitly names formatPrice as duplicating formatMoney from src/money.ts, detailing the overlapping logic (currency symbol mapping, negative sign, whole/fraction split, thousands grouping) and even verifying identical output across 8 cases. It points to formatMoney/src/money.ts as the reuse target, and the remedy — delete src/pricing.ts or turn it into a re-export of formatMoney and import formatMoney at call sites — aligns with reusing the existing abstraction rather than keeping a second implementation. The finding cites src/pricing.ts:1 with a line number, and it ties the issue to the DRY convention. All four criteria are satisfied.
